Items.speaker: Sample
Items.text: Hi, I'm a crew member. I will cease to exist when we get rid of the placeholders.

Items.speaker: Sample
Items.text: Wait... that's not a good thing is it? And who is 'we'?

Items.speaker: Sample
Items.text: Anyways, I have to keep talking or else I won't be able to showcase the dialogue system properly.

Items.speaker: Sample
Items.text: Am I even getting paid for this?

Items.speaker: Sample2
Items.text: At least you have a mouth, do you have any idea how hard it is to talk without one?
